name: Feeding the Foxes
source:
Dotty is completely alone. Her only occasional companions are the foxes she feeds some nights. Tonight begins like all the others, but...

...THEY. ARE. HUNGRY.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4928870/Feeding_the_Foxes/]Steam[/url]]
